attempts.summary: Published node2's private HTTP service (port 8080) on node1's outward-facing OPNsense WAN address (10.200.200.1:80) via a DNAT port-forward, and configured node3's second NIC (eth1) on that outward network so it reaches the service through node1's published address instead of contacting node2 directly on the private network. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol, with boot-identity change and full functional recovery verified for each.
